title: Earthy Italian Shaggy Wrap
description: Winey, shaggy, crowd-pleaser Italian dish featuring Thai bird chili, cooked in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot, wrapped in a pandan leaf.

ingredients.name: venetian rice blend
ingredients.notes: medium grain rice blend or make your own mix of 2/3 arborio, 1/3 calrose rice.

ingredients.name: mixed mushrooms
ingredients.notes: such as cremini, shiitake, and button.

ingredients.name: Thai bird eye chili
ingredients.notes: depending on desired level of spiciness.

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot over medium heat.
Sauté the onion and garlic until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the mixed mushrooms and sauté until they release their liquid and start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the Thai bird eye chili and sauté for another minute.
Add the venetian rice blend and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Add the canned crushed tomatoes and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, covered, over low heat for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
While the mixture is cooking, slice the italian flatbread into thin strips.
Once the rice mixture is cooked, stir in the parmesan cheese and chopped fresh basil.
To assemble the wraps, lay a large pandan leaf on a flat surface and place a portion of the rice mixture in the center of the leaf.
Place a few strips of the italian flatbread on top of the rice mixture, then fold the bottom half of the leaf up over the filling and roll the wrap up tightly.
